description: This PHP source file defines the LocationMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface for configuring menu items related to 'Locations' in the OrangeHRM system. It includes namespace declarations, use statements, and a method to override the current screen to 'viewLocations'.

classes.name: LocationMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for location-related screens by overriding the current screen to 'viewLocations'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu by overriding the current screen to 'viewLocations' and returns null.
